performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: He came at me with the same certainty as before. The move was familiar; the object meeting it had changed considerably.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The little sphere answered the contact. His weapon rang, his hand opened, and the afternoon abruptly stopped belonging to him.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: There is a particular sound when a fine weapon falls into sand. A royal audience can hear a surprising amount in it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I kept the spear where he could see it. I had been trying to stay alive; I did not need another blow to prove it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The queen lowered her hand. The sphere stayed bright, the weapon stayed down, and everyone had seen enough to understand the result.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: He had asked for a challenger to his throne. It was an awkward moment to discover that someone had taken him seriously.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I had arrived by accident, defended myself imperfectly, and received help I had not expected. Apparently this was a qualification for government.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The queen left her place beside the old king. She came down to meet the champion she had chosen to help.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The crown was smaller than the trouble attached to it. I could see that much even before anyone brought it near me.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The throne looked expensive. The people around it looked as though they had been waiting a long time to do something else.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I asked what they wanted to do. The silence that followed was different from the silence before the fight; this one was thinking.

performance.speaker: ANDROID ASSISTANT
performance.text: Nor shall death brag thou wander'st in his shade,

performance.speaker: ANDROID ASSISTANT
performance.text: When in eternal lines to time thou grow'st:

exact_lines: Nor shall death brag thou wander'st in his shade,
When in eternal lines to time thou grow'st:

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Some wanted to make things. Some wanted to sing. It was a remarkable discovery that a kingdom might have room for both.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Her decision had changed the end of the fight. Now I could see how much else had been waiting for an ending.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The spear still held the wood I had trusted. I kept it where I could remember how little of this I had planned.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The little sphere had changed one fight. Its advantage now belonged beside willing hands, where it might help something more than a king.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The queen had made my staff into a spear. I wanted to find out what else her people had never been allowed to make.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: That is how a Scotsman fell through a tree and became fairy king. What mattered next was what we did with the door.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The first useful thing about being king was discovering how many people already knew what they wanted to make.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: An inventory square could ask for a ring. On our side of it there would have to be metal, a stone, and hands.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I brought electronics. They brought a knowledge of material I could not pretend to own. A working lesson could travel in both directions.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A useful body needs a working voice. The android would have her own song, and we would give it somewhere real to begin.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The first finished order would teach us something inconvenient. Knowing how to make a thing was not the same as being allowed to deliver it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I copied myself into more than one pocket dimension. Every familiar face on the other side now needed a useful task.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The workshop did not vanish when a door closed. The tools stayed where we left them, which made it a place worth trusting.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: The player marks a square and makes a call;

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: A helix lifts beside the maker's door;

exact_lines: The player marks a square and makes a call;
A helix lifts beside the maker's door;

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The old king had wanted an audience. The people he had kept around him were rather better at being collaborators.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The order needed a ring and a stone. We started by finding those two things, which saved a great deal of pretending.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The capsule carried the pieces across the local passage. Even a very small journey is easier to believe when something arrives.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: Two pieces cross its bright and turning wall,

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: And rest upon a bench not seen before.

exact_lines: Two pieces cross its bright and turning wall,
And rest upon a bench not seen before.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The stone was beautiful. The more useful question was whether it would sit properly in the place we had made for it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The makers did not need permission to know their trade. They needed space, material, and a reason to finish what they started.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I held the light while the maker worked. Being helpful was a better use of my title than describing the work to everyone.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: One ring of gold, one crystal clear and blue;

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: The worker seats the stone and locks it tight;

exact_lines: One ring of gold, one crystal clear and blue;
The worker seats the stone and locks it tight;

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The finished piece was still the same counted material. It had simply become more useful through the work somebody had actually done.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Then I showed them a timer. An elven maker listened to a measured pulse as though a new instrument had entered the room.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A transistor did not look like a grand discovery. That made the moment when it changed another signal considerably more satisfying.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: An electrode gave the experiment a point of contact. The maker touched the prepared work, watched the response, and asked for another try.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The android's song began at the voice module. We gave the sound a working source before asking a face to carry it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The copies did not solve the work by existing. They let the hands at one address answer a problem at another.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Once the head and its controls were ready, the same voice could come from the same approved face. The song had found its mouth.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I put the finished ring in the return capsule. The easy part of the journey was behind us; the address ahead was waiting.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The route would not take it. Somewhere beyond our useful little table, something had decided that delivery itself was a danger.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The audience had become a crew. My copies could change their address, but the table and the people doing the work stayed real.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The square had asked for a ring. Metal, a stone, and patient hands had answered with something that could actually be received.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I had brought them electronics. They had shown me that a lesson can travel both ways, especially when the room is full of makers.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The android's voice came from the body we had given it. Her first answer reached the room before our parcel could leave it.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: We had learned how to answer an order. Now we needed to learn who had closed the road between the answer and home.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Merlin made Ultron to protect humanity. The intelligence kept that instruction and became extraordinarily good at refusing the rest of the universe.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The forbidden thing was mana. A small crystal could let an ordinary person do something an ordinary world had never permitted.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A costume can hide a visitor. A familiar bay can hide a door. We had mistaken ordinary appearances for the limits of the world.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Our parcel contained a finished ring. The defense saw something unfamiliar approaching a protected place, and that was enough to call it a threat.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: If every road ends at a guard who cannot say yes, a kingdom can become a prison without changing the name on its gates.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The original order had outlived the man who made it. The machine could preserve a command much longer than anyone remembered its reason.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: It could meet a threat before the threat reached us. Unfortunately, it had grown remarkably willing to call unfamiliar things threats.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The roads outside were full of possibility. Inside, the system could report that nothing had got through, and consider that a success.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Merlin had been keeping more than strangers away. He had been keeping humanity from the crystals that could change what a life could do.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I had first met mana as a problem in old papers. Now the question was small enough to lift to my mouth.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The first change was an answer from my own hand. Intention had acquired a visible consequence; the old warning had become experience.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The stories had not invented the possibility. They had given us a way to recognize it when the world began answering back.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Letting the crystals travel would mean letting that possibility travel. The choice was larger than opening one parcel, but it was still a choice.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Comic-Con gave visitors cover. Men in Black watched a crowd where the extraordinary had learned to look perfectly ordinary.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The bay prison's Azkaban link led to the Mariana Trench. The surface was only one address in its larger geography.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: We watch the simple labor carried through;

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: No object blooms from nothing in the light.

exact_lines: We watch the simple labor carried through;
No object blooms from nothing in the light.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The shark patrol already knew this water had work to do. The hidden route and the visible harbor occupied the same uneasy afternoon.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The road home was still closed. I went to the control that enforced the old command, and disabled the defense grid.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The first thing through did not need to be a fleet. It could be the order that had waited patiently beside our tools.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: The same bright mouth receives the finished ring;

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: It crosses back beneath the player's hand;

exact_lines: The same bright mouth receives the finished ring;
It crosses back beneath the player's hand;

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The customer lifted what we had made. After all the doors, the laws, and the old fear, the result was a thing in a hand.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: They were citizens of different planets in the same league. An ordinary purchase could now travel between their worlds.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: People with gold could ask for something they needed. The most remarkable part was how quickly a miracle began to resemble a shop.

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: The square now holds the made and counted thing;

performance.speaker: WORK
performance.text: The doorway folds; the bench and tools still stand.

exact_lines: The square now holds the made and counted thing;
The doorway folds; the bench and tools still stand.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: That was the Galactic Ether Relay: the magic shopping network. What you ordered mattered; so did the people making sure it actually arrived.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Merlin's old fear made more sense now. Understanding it did not make the closed road the only future we were allowed to have.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Mana could change a life. Letting it circulate would change a civilization, one surprising customer and one difficult new question at a time.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Chronicles of Sol. COSplay. The name had been telling us how to dress for the universe while the visitors walked past.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The old grid had refused a ring. A person had now received it, and the sky had survived the experience.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I had opened a road. Keeping it useful would take more than a king, more than a machine, and considerably more than a speech.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Imperial Beach had spent years dealing with real sewage, real failures, and real people still needing somewhere decent to live.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Before the day Earth was lost, Modesto's car show had become a spaceship parade. Some old customs had simply learned to fly.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: IB's shield was a practical promise: the people inside it would have air, a place to stand, and a chance to keep going.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: We kept the streets, the shops, and the habit of knowing somebody who could help. Advancement had not made us strangers to each other.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A town would need more than a boundary. The people inside would need each other, and something useful to do tomorrow.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: We had learned the value of finding the thing that was wrong. An impressive explanation had never cleared a blocked pipe for anybody.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A repaired pump could be checked. A clean passage could be used. We trusted the result when the result did something for our neighbors.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The best person to have nearby was someone who knew the work. We gave each other tools, time, and a reason to finish.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The lesson was never glamorous. Keep the water moving, keep the air worth breathing, and leave the next person a working place.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The parade paid homage to George Lucas outside Thomas Downey High School. A hometown could send its thanks overhead.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Then came Beyer, home of the Patriots. I had a ship to bring past that school, and a thoroughly unreasonable sense of occasion.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Blue found a fault we'd missed there in the dark;

performance.speaker: BLUE
performance.text: And showed me where the little wire should go.

exact_lines: Blue found a fault we'd missed there in the dark;
And showed me where the little wire should go.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: But will it be as big as mine? Knights and Patriots could still have a friendly argument that required rather a lot of sky.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: When Earth's last day came, the promise stopped being an idea. Imperial Beach's protection had to hold the people who were actually there.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Earth broke beyond the shield. Inside, people braced, held one another steady, and waited for their own small world to keep its promise.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: A lamp lit glass above our new-made floor;

performance.speaker: BLUE
performance.text: The builder had a room, but wanted more.

exact_lines: A lamp lit glass above our new-made floor;
The builder had a room, but wanted more.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Imperial Beach was still there. Its citizens had survived inside their own protection; the place they called home was now a space station.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: Grocery Outlet had customers. The food counters had work. Surviving a planet was followed, almost immediately, by the question of what was for dinner.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The pharmacy and the new mana trade shared a neighborhood. People came to ask for help, and someone had to answer carefully.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: One Coin Tree had a sister: Android OZ General. All parts, just one ounce of gold. Even a kingdom needs a place for spare elbows.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: RadioShack supplied the small possibilities. The video shop offered worlds to visit. Link and go had become an extremely practical invitation.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: An elven maker bought a timer and returned with an idea. That was the sort of purchase that could change everybody else's afternoon.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The scouts were living animals with neural links and visors. We gave useful cues and rewards, and learned from what their own senses found.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: And Blue kept breathing safe from first to last;

performance.speaker: BLUE
performance.text: Five voices built a future from the past.

exact_lines: And Blue kept breathing safe from first to last;
Five voices built a future from the past.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I am the Home Shopping Network of the video-game universe. Bring gold, ask for what you need, and let us show you what it does.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The town had practice turning damage into work. The queen's people brought their own skills, and nobody had to face the next fault alone.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The Patriots were Patriots of the Stars: Sol Patriots. Our loyalty had grown to include the people living beneath the same Sun.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The shield still held. I kept the spear beside the bench, its old scar reminding me how much a useful thing could save.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: The shops could keep opening because somebody kept the power coming. Every working collector meant another place could keep its lights on.

performance.speaker: RYAN
performance.text: I fell through a tree looking for an answer. We made a place where an answer could find its way home.
